# Configuration

FairLB Community uses environment variables. `DATABASE_URL` is the only required
value in the shipped Compose deployment; the remaining defaults suit one instance.
Every secret accepts a mutually exclusive `<NAME>_FILE` alternative. Blank values
use the built-in default, matching the shipped Compose file.

Run `fairlb config check` to validate without connecting to external services and
to print redacted effective values, their source, and optional-feature state.

| Variable | Type | Default | Required when | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_PER_IP_RPM` | int32 | `10` | — | Authentication requests per IP per minute. |
| `BRAND_PROFILE_DIR` | path | `—` | — | Directory holding the brand bundle to serve; empty serves the brand built into the image. A named directory that cannot be loaded stops startup. |
| `DATABASE_URL` | secret url | `—` | runtime and database commands | PostgreSQL connection string. |
| `DATABASE_URL_FILE` | file | `—` | alternative to DATABASE_URL | Path containing DATABASE_URL; mutually exclusive with the direct value. |
| `DB_POOL_MAX_CONNS` | int32 | `pgx default` | — | Maximum PostgreSQL pool size; unset delegates to the product default. |
| `DRAIN_GRACE_SECONDS` | seconds | `0` | — | Delay between readiness failure and server shutdown. |
| `DRIVER_BREAKER` | enum | `memory` | — | Circuit-breaker driver: memory or redis. |
| `DRIVER_CACHE` | enum | `memory` | — | Cache driver: memory or redis. |
| `DRIVER_LOCK` | enum | `memory` | — | Distributed lock driver: memory or redis. |
| `DRIVER_RATELIMIT` | enum | `memory` | — | Rate-limit driver: memory or redis. |
| `FAIRLB_ADMIN_EMAIL` | string | `—` | with FAIRLB_ADMIN_PASSWORD | Optional first administrator email. |
| `FAIRLB_ADMIN_PASSWORD` | secret string | `—` | with FAIRLB_ADMIN_EMAIL | Optional first administrator password. |
| `FAIRLB_ADMIN_PASSWORD_FILE` | file | `—` | alternative to FAIRLB_ADMIN_PASSWORD | Path containing FAIRLB_ADMIN_PASSWORD; mutually exclusive with the direct value. |
| `FAIRLB_DATA_DIR` | path | `/data` | — | Persistent Community state directory. |
| `FAIRLB_PROBE_TRACE` | bool | `false` | — | Expose provider routing trace details. |
| `FAIRLB_SETUP_TOKEN` | secret string | `—` | — | Optional setup-page token of at least 32 characters. |
| `FAIRLB_SETUP_TOKEN_FILE` | file | `—` | alternative to FAIRLB_SETUP_TOKEN | Path containing FAIRLB_SETUP_TOKEN; mutually exclusive with the direct value. |
| `HTTP_ADDR` | address | `:8080` | — | Public HTTP listen address. |
| `INTERNAL_ADDR` | address | `:9091` | — | Internal health and metrics listen address. |
| `LOG_FORMAT` | enum | `text` | — | Log encoding: text or json. |
| `PUBLIC_URL` | url | `http://localhost:8080` | — | Public origin used for cookies and setup links. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_DISABLED` | bool | `false` | — | Explicitly disable all rate limiting. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_PER_IP_RPM` | int32 | `300` | — | General requests per IP per minute. |
| `REDIS_URL` | secret url | `—` | when any shared driver uses redis | Redis connection string. |
| `REDIS_URL_FILE` | file | `—` | alternative to REDIS_URL | Path containing REDIS_URL; mutually exclusive with the direct value. |
| `SECRET_KEY` | secret hex | `—` | Cloud outside dev; Community persists one when absent | 64-hex-character AES-256 master key. |
| `SECRET_KEY_FILE` | file | `—` | alternative to SECRET_KEY | Path containing SECRET_KEY; mutually exclusive with the direct value. |
| `SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` | seconds | `320` | — | Total graceful server shutdown budget. |
| `TRUST_PROXY` | bool | `false` | — | Trust forwarded client and scheme headers. |
| `TRUST_PROXY_HOPS` | int32 | `1` | — | Number of trusted reverse-proxy hops. |

OpenTelemetry exporter variables are consumed by the OTel adapter directly and
retain the standard names defined by the OpenTelemetry SDK.
